title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol to 14x speed
summary: OpenAI has launched 'Ultrafast,' a new mode for its GPT-5.6 Sol model that increases processing speed by 14 times, delivering up to 750 output tokens per second. This advancement enables real-time performance without sacrificing model size or specialization, targeting applications like incident response, customer service, financial analysis, and e-commerce. Ultrafast is powered by a partnership with chipmaker Cerebras and is currently in preview for select customers, with plans to expand access as capacity grows.
key_points: OpenAI introduces 'Ultrafast,' a mode that accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol to 14x its standard speed.
Ultrafast delivers up to 750 output tokens per second, enabling real-time performance without model downsizing.
The feature is designed for corporate workflows like incident response, customer service, financial analysis, and e-commerce.
Powered by OpenAI’s partnership with chipmaker Cerebras.
Currently in preview for a limited group of customers; access will expand with capacity growth.
Competitors like Anthropic offer similar fast modes, but Ultrafast claims superior speed.
